title: My Mallworld has disappeared.
content: When I first found this sub, I was amazed, grateful, mystified, just to name a few emotions. I really couldn’t believe it at first but the more stories I read, the happier I felt, I wasn’t alone, other people had dreams like mine and it was really an awesome discovery for me. My mall dreams were exhausting and almost every night. The recurring theme was finding myself in a typical mall and trying to find my way to the parking lot and my car, and the further I wandered into the Mall, the worse conditions became, and people were nowhere to be seen. Well, that was weeks ago, and since I discovered this sub, and binged read it all, I haven’t had one Mallworld dream since. Not anything, not even a twinge. I don’t know how I feel about this TBH. I think I feel somewhat perplexed, but my anxiety level is way better. Maybe I need an explanation why the dreams would stop after all these years when I learned my dreams were not unique.
